system.description: A shard of a consecrated brass mask that still whispers. Once per day, you have Boon on a Presence test to command, persuade or intimidate. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◈ Speak in the Council's voice: every humanoid within 60' that hears you, except Strong and Mighty foes, is Charmed by you for 1 minute. It ends for any creature you harm.
system.drawback: The Council of Many learns your face. The Wickguard treats you as a suspect.
